name: Primes in Interval
description: You are given two integers a and b ( a ≤ b ). How many prime numbers are there on the interval from a to b , inclusive?
input_specification: The input contains two integers a and b ( 2 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ 1 000 000 ), separated by a single space.
output_specification: Output a single integer — the number of primes between a and b , inclusive.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
